title: Web: strength trend
description: Whether lifting is improving overall (fa_coach.strength_trend), as a daily series ending on the day. Each day's point looks back over the training.strength_trend_days (28) days ending that day: every counting lift trained in them gives its latest estimated 1RM (heaviest working set; effective load for bodyweight lifts) as % of its first one in that window (after its latest baseline reset there, if any; a lift trained once is at 100); the point is the mean over those lifts. The rate is the last point's change in % per week over the window. Shown on Home's Workouts card (14 days) and at the top of the Training tab.

window_days.description: training.strength_trend_days: the look-back of each point and of the rate.

end.description: The last point's day: the shown day.

pct.description: Mean % of the window-start value (100 = unchanged), 1 decimal; null without a counting lift trained in the window.

rate_pct_per_week.description: As of the last day, the mean over the counting lifts of each lift's change (latest as % of first in the window, after its reset) per week of its own span (first to latest session, at least 7 days), 1 decimal; null without a counting lift.

direction.description: rising above +training.e1rm_same_band_pct (% per week), falling below its negative, flat within; null with the rate null.

lifts.description: Counting lifts in the last point.

lifts_trained.description: Counting lifts with any usable session in the window ending on the last day (2+ sessions not needed); 0 means nothing was trained.
